rationale: The buyer is identifiable — an eng lead or technical founder at a 2-20 person dev-community SaaS, who already uses paid help-desk tools and is explicitly evaluating AI automation, giving a real budget signal. The pain is real and daily: every duplicate bug report across Discord, GitHub, and email wastes developer time, which has a direct, measurable dollar cost. The deciding factor holding this to 'validate' is that no response signal exists yet and this is a crowded space (Linear, Plain, Unito, Zapier all partially address it), so we need at least a 10-reply HN/Discord thread or a landing-page waitlist before committing to build.
solution_plan: The micro-service is an AI-powered duplicate-report deduplicator and cross-channel aggregator for small dev teams — it listens to Discord, GitHub Issues, and email, clusters semantically similar reports, and posts a unified summary with a canonical issue link. The factory builds this as a Claude prompt pipeline connected via webhooks (Discord bot token, GitHub webhook, email forwarding alias) feeding into a lightweight web dashboard hosted on a static page; a Stripe subscription link handles billing at ~$49/mo per workspace, with a 14-day free trial captured via an intake form — Youval touches nothing except approving the outreach batch. To sell, the factory identifies Discord servers of open-source/indie SaaS projects (public Discord invites + GitHub topics), posts a targeted 'are you drowning in duplicate bug reports?' message in #support or #dev channels, and DMs eng leads — all outreach queued for Youval's one-time approval before sending. Ongoing: new reports are ingested automatically, Claude clusters and labels them, and weekly digest emails go to the customer's team; billing renews via Stripe, support questions are answered by a Claude-backed help bot. The only recurring human touch is approving outreach batches and reviewing any flagged edge cases flagged by the system.
notes: operational_autonomy scored 7 (meets gate floor of 7 exactly) — viable but thin margin. buildability_with_ai at 7 is achievable but Discord bot + GitHub webhook + email ingestion is non-trivial integration work; factory tooling can handle it but plan for 2-week build. No responsiveness signal yet — validate with a landing page or HN comment before building.
